paper_metadata.title: High temperature tribological performance of a cost-effective eutectic high entropy alloy Al0.8CrFeNi2.2: Comparison with AlCoCrFeNi2.1

evidence.quote: A comprehensive comparison study on microstructure, mechanical and high temperature tribological performance of as-cast Al0.8CrFeNi2.2 and AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic high entropy alloys was conducted.
A low-cost Co-free Al0.8CrFeNi2.2 EHEA was recently announced by Jin et al. [32] after removing all Co and adjusting the mixing ratio between Al and Ni from the original AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA.

The mixed pellets were placed into a clean vacuum chamber of the arc-melting furnace with an in-place chill casting onto a water-cooled copper hearth. The chamber was sealed and then vacuumed to ~0.01 MPa. The chamber was then flushed with high-purity argon air and repetitively evacuated to eliminate the retained oxygen within the chamber. During arc-melting, two titanium getters were first melted to further absorb the remained oxygen to avoid the oxidation of pellets. Then, the mixed pellets were melted. In order to achieve a chemical composition homogeneity within the as-cast EHEAs ingots, melting was repeated for at least five times.
